Filter by item code, issuer ticker or CIK, or since-date. Returns a {data, total, limit, offset} envelope.

cik.description: SEC CIK number, digits only (leading zeros optional).

limit.description: Rows to return (max 25 on this endpoint).

offset.description: Rows to skip — page through 'total' with limit+offset.

since.description: Only filings filed on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

ticker.description: Issuer ticker symbol, e.g. KMI. 8-K headers carry no ticker, so it is resolved to a CIK via this dataset's Form 4 filings — an issuer with no Form 4 yet needs 'cik' instead.

until.description: Only filings filed on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD) — with since, a fixed reproducible window.

name: get_insider_filing
title: One insider ownership filing

description: List normalized SEC insider ownership filings (Form 4 transactions, plus Form 3 initial statements and Form 5 annual statements — 3/5 live-forward since 2026-09-23), newest first: non-derivative and derivative transaction legs, holdings, owner roles (director/officer/10% owner), footnotes, and amendment (/A) links. Numeric values are strings exactly as filed; every object carries 'accession' and 'filed_date'. Filter by issuer ticker, issuer CIK, reporting-owner CIK (owner_cik — one insider's filings across every issuer), form_type, or since-date. Returns a {data, total, limit, offset} envelope for paging. For day- or market-wide sweeps, set compact=true: one summary row per filing (issuer, owners with roles, leg counts, open-market purchase/sale share + as-filed dollar aggregates) and up to 100 rows per call instead of 25 — then fetch any filing's full detail with get_insider_filing. Hosted and already normalized — no EDGAR crawling, parsing, or local install needed.

cik.description: SEC CIK number, digits only (leading zeros optional).

compact.description: true returns one compact survey row per filing — issuer, owners with roles, non-derivative/derivative leg counts, and open-market (code P/S) share + as-filed dollar aggregates computed from the filed numbers — and raises the row cap to 100. Sized for day- or market-wide sweeps; fetch full detail per filing with get_insider_filing.

form_type.description: 3 = initial ownership, 4 = transactions, 5 = annual statement; /A = amendment. Forms 3/5 are live-forward since 2026-09-23.

limit.description: Rows to return — max 25 for full filing objects, 100 with compact=true.

offset.description: Rows to skip — page through 'total' with limit+offset.

owner_cik.description: Reporting owner (insider) CIK, digits only — one person or entity's filings across every issuer. Owner CIKs appear in each filing's reporting_owners[].

since.description: Only filings filed on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

ticker.description: Issuer ticker symbol, e.g. KMI. Case-insensitive; matches each symbol of a multi-listed filing ('WSO; WSOB' matches WSO).

until.description: Only filings filed on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD) — with since, a fixed reproducible window.
